For the next few months, we are going to go with a weekly discussion thread. Every week, we will highlight one console, and talk about your favorite game for the system. If you don't own the console, please feel free to comment and ask questions, maybe it will be one you decide to pick up in the future!

This week, we are starting with the Wii. What is your favorite Wii game? Do you like Nintendo's step into motion controls?

Although Wii games can be played on the Wii U, and Gamecube games on the Wii, please try to stick with Wii games for the sake of this discussion. Loophole: Metroid Prime Trilogy, Pikmin, etc., that have been Gamecube games remade for the Wii with motion controls

Mine is easily Fragile Dreams. It is such a good game and I love everything about it. The setting is really cool with lots of interesting areas. The soundtrack is beautiful and matches the theme of the game very well. The art style is great too with a very well done anime inspired style. I really recommend checking out a trailer and playing it for anyone who owns a Wii.
Never heard of Fragile Dreams! What type of game is it?
It is a post apocalyptic journey style game. It is more story driven than combat. There is some combat though.

Super Mario Galaxy. Got it for Christmas 2007, that game is just pure joy. Incredible, original level design and game mechanics, tons of content. It's truly a magical game and single handedly re-ignited my passion for gaming.
